svg.aria-label: From each kubelet to one metrics API: 1. Poll: Every 15 seconds metrics-server asks each node's kubelet for CPU and memory, over the node status port. 2. Hold: It keeps only the latest sample in memory. There is no history store, so a restart empties the window. 3. Aggregate: The API server proxies metrics.k8s.io to the metrics-server Service through an APIService object. 4. Read: kubectl top, the descheduler and the HorizontalPodAutoscaler read the same API, and Prometheus scrapes the server.
